items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewer identifies 'Little Belly' as Willie Umfrey Sr. The interviewee only comments on the family ('they had one son that played trombone') without indicating a personal relationship or direct interaction with Little Belly himself.

ctx.x: Is that the young Willie Umfrey? His father was named Willie too.
Yes, but the father was a father. We used to call him Little Belly. He was so fat, you know. They both play clarinet. Yes.
